title: Triceps
summary: The three-headed muscle on the back of the upper arm. All three heads straighten the elbow; the long head also crosses the shoulder. Overhead extensions grew the triceps clearly more than pushdowns in a direct comparison.

what_it_is.overview: The app splits the triceps into two map regions: the long head (inner strip) and the lateral and medial heads together (outer horseshoe). Weekly targets count the whole muscle.

heads.name: Long head
heads.origin: Just below the shoulder socket (the infraglenoid tubercle of the shoulder blade).
heads.insertion: The point of the elbow (olecranon), through the shared triceps tendon.
heads.fiber_direction: Runs down the inner back of the arm; fibres are pennate (set at an angle like a feather).

heads.name: Lateral head
heads.origin: The back of the upper-arm bone, high up and to the outside.
heads.insertion: The point of the elbow, through the shared tendon.
heads.fiber_direction: Runs down the outer back of the arm, forming the outer horseshoe.

heads.name: Medial head
heads.origin: The back of the lower upper-arm bone, deep under the other two heads.
heads.insertion: The point of the elbow, through the shared tendon.
heads.fiber_direction: Runs down under the long and lateral heads, near the elbow.

what_it_does.detail: The job in every press, pushdown and extension.

what_it_does.action: Helps pull the arm down and back (shoulder extension and adduction).
what_it_does.detail: Why the long head is stretched with the arm overhead and works a little in straight-arm pulldowns and pullovers.

synergists.name: Anconeus
synergists.role: Small muscle that helps straighten the elbow; not tracked.

synergists.name: Chest and front delts
synergists.role: Do the shoulder part of every press while the triceps straighten the elbow.

synergists.name: Lats and rear delts
synergists.role: Shoulder extension with the long head.

antagonists.name: Biceps and brachialis
antagonists.role: Bend the elbow, the direct opposite.

stabilizer_roles.text: In rows and pulldowns the long head helps steady the shoulder; the library rates triceps 0 or below 0.25 there.
Pullovers and straight-arm pulldowns use the long head for shoulder extension; pullovers are rated 0.25 to 0.3 for triceps.

indirect.note: A compound press rated as a main triceps mover.
Below the 0.25 cut-off, so it adds nothing to this muscle's sets.

relationships.indirect_note: Each working set adds the exercise's rating for this muscle to the weekly total, and ratings under 0.25 count as 0. 4 sets of barbell bench press (0.5), 3 sets of overhead cable triceps extension (1.0) and 3 sets of triceps pushdown (1.0) give 2 + 3 + 3 = 8, which the panel shows as 8 (rounded to the nearest 0.5). The full list comes live from exercises.json; the rows above are examples and the ratings are coaching estimates.

bias.goal: Long-head bias: work with the arm overhead

how.joint_angle: Shoulder raised so the upper arm points up.
how.stretch_position: Elbow fully bent behind the head with the arm overhead, which stretches the long head across both joints.
how.stance: Standing facing away from a cable, seated, or on a machine.

bias.caveat: Same wording as the swap tag 'Triceps long-head bias'. In the study the lateral and medial heads also grew more overhead, even with about a third less load.

how.joint_angle: Upper arm at the side or in front (pushdowns, presses, kickbacks).

bias.caveat: The short heads cross only the elbow, so they work in every elbow extension. The map rates pushdowns short 1.0 and long 0.6.

how.grip: Hands about shoulder width on a bar.

bias.caveat: Heavier loads and more systemic fatigue than isolation.

how.joint_angle: Upper arm behind the body, hardest at lockout.

bias.caveat: Kickbacks are tagged 'Peak-contraction focus'; no growth advantage is shown, and they are hardest where the triceps is short.

best_exercises.why: Overhead position grew the triceps about 1.4-fold more than pushdowns, most of all the long head.
Same overhead position with a rope; stretch emphasis and long-head bias.
Overhead extension on a guided path; easy to push to failure.
Long range with the elbow fully bent; stretch-biased in the app.
Simple, loadable work for the lateral and medial heads with cable tension.
Heavy compound press; triceps 1.0 with chest 0.6.

mistakes.text: Letting the elbows drift forward and down on pushdowns so the lats and chest help.
Flaring the elbows wide on overhead extensions, which shortens the range.
Stopping short of a full stretch on overhead work; that range is where the extra growth was seen.
Doing only pushdowns when overhead work is available.

coach_cues.cue: Elbows pointed at the ceiling, reach deep behind your head.
coach_cues.why: Loads the long head in its stretch.

coach_cues.cue: Pin the upper arm; only the forearm moves.
coach_cues.why: Keeps the work on elbow extension.
Uses the whole range under control.

coach_cues.cue: Lower slowly, especially near the stretch.

notes: Weekly target in the app: 8 to 18 triceps sets at Advanced. Intermediate and Beginner scale the minimum by 0.8 and 0.6; the maximum stays the same. Render the numbers from targets.json, not from this text.
Maeo 2023 measured untrained adults with cable extensions, comparing overhead and pushdown arm positions. It supports overhead work, not dropping pushdowns or presses.
The long/short split on the map is shading only; weekly targets count the whole triceps.
